metadata.description: Generate and publish GitHub profile AI coding heatmaps with WakaTime-style tool usage cards. Supports Claude, Codex, CodeFuse, OpenCode, CodeBuddy, Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Continue, Aider, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and custom JSON/JSONL sources.

plugins.name: vibetrace
plugins.description: Set up a GitHub profile repo, generate AI coding heatmaps, add tool usage cards, preserve existing README content, commit, and push through /vibe.
